datasets.title: Falkland Islands ( Malvinas) Buildings (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 5.4 thousand buildings in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 50% of the total buildings.The average age of data for this region is 5 years ( Last edited 3 months ago ) and 2% buildings were added or updated in the last 6 months. Read about what this summary means : indicators , metrics This theme includes all OpenStreetMap features in this area matching ( Learn what tags means here ) : tags['building'] IS NOT NULL Features may have these attributes: name name:en building building:levels building:materials addr:full addr:housenumber addr:street addr:city office source This dataset is one of many OpenStreetMap exports on HDX . See the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team website for more information.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/hotosm_flk_buildings]

lineage.description: Building footprints and attributes were extracted from the OpenStreetMap database by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team's raw data API. The dataset represents volunteered geographic information collected and edited by OSM contributors, with approximately 50% estimated completeness based on AI-mapping validation. Data quality metrics indicate an average age of 5 years with recent updates in the last 6 months.
